heading.en: Cash in the drawer, cash in the bank

hook.en: Most firms keep only a little cash in the office and the rest in a bank account. One cash book with two columns can track both.

body.en: This cash book has two amount columns on each side: Cash and Bank. Cash received is entered in the cash column, cheques deposited and amounts received directly in the bank are entered in the bank column; payments by cheque are entered in the bank column on the credit side. The cash and bank columns are balanced separately.
body.kn: ಈ ನಗದು ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಗದು ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಎಂಬ ಎರಡು ಕಾಲಂಗಳಿವೆ. ಚೆಕ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಪಾವತಿ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಕಾಲಂನಲ್ಲಿ. ಎರಡೂ ಕಾಲಂಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಶಿಲ್ಕು ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Cash book with a bank column

say.en: Two amount columns on each side: cash and bank. Start with the opening balances.
Cash sales go in the cash column. Depositing cash: bank column debit, cash column credit. Mark it C.
Paid Vinod by cheque: bank column credit. Withdrew 5,000 for office: cash debit, bank credit, again a contra entry.
A cheque from Farhan deposited the same day goes straight to the bank column.
Balance each column separately: cash 18,000 and bank 47,000.
Contra entries marked C appear on both sides and are not posted to the ledger.

body.en: When cash is deposited into the bank, the bank column is debited and the cash column credited. When cash is withdrawn from the bank for office use, the cash column is debited and the bank column credited. Such entries appear on both sides of the cash book and are marked "C" in the L.F. column; they are not posted to the ledger.
body.kn: ನಗದು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಗೆ ಜಮಾ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಕಾಲಂ ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ನಗದು ಕಾಲಂ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್. ಕಚೇರಿ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನಿಂದ ತೆಗೆದಾಗ ಅದರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ. ಇವು ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನಮೂದುಗಳು, "C" ಎಂದು ಗುರುತು.

points.en: Withdrawal for office: Dr cash, Cr bank

problem.en: Prepare the double column cash book of Shetty & Co. for June 2025: June 1 cash ₹10,000, bank ₹40,000; June 5 cash sales ₹18,000; June 8 deposited ₹15,000 into bank; June 12 paid Vinod by cheque ₹12,000; June 18 withdrew ₹5,000 from bank for office use; June 25 received a cheque ₹9,000 from Farhan and deposited it the same day.

steps.en: Debit (cash | bank): Balance b/d 10,000 | 40,000; Sales 18,000 | –; Cash (C) – | 15,000; Bank (C) 5,000 | –; Farhan – | 9,000.

answer.en: Cash in hand ₹18,000; cash at bank ₹47,000

body.en: Money moving between your pocket and your bank account is a contra entry: it appears on both sides, marked C, and never goes to the ledger.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಎರಡು ಕಾಲಂ ನಗದು ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ನಗದು ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಕಾಲಂಗಳಿವೆ. ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನಮೂದುಗಳು C ಗುರುತು ಹೊಂದಿ ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತವೆ. ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಕಾಲಂನ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಶಿಲ್ಕು ಓವರ್‌ಡ್ರಾಫ್ಟ್.
